1.title: Sense of Appreciation
1.intro: Sara has been in the Children's Medical Center for a week. She has caught a terrible flu. The doctor told her to stay there to get better. There is a photograph of an old man on the wall. While the nurse is taking her temperature, they start talking.

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.text: Excuse me, who is that man in the picture?

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Oh, don't you know him? Have you ever heard of Dr. Mohammad Gharib?

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.text: I guess I have only seen his name in my English book, but I'm not sure about it.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Dr. Gharib was a famous physician.

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.text: Oh,... can you tell me a little about his life?

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Dr. Gharib was born in Tehran in 1288. After receiving his diploma, he went abroad to study medicine. In 1316 he became a physician and then came back to his homeland. In 1347 this center was founded by Dr. Gharib and one of his close friends.

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.text: Really? I didn't know that.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: Dr. Gharib was also a generous man. He spared no pains to cure sick children. He was very friendly and helpful to poor families. Not surprisingly, he was regarded as a dedicated physician.

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.text: It 's a pity! I didn't know such a great man.

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: He was known as a distinguished university professor, too. The first Persian textbook on children's diseases was written by him. He taught medicine to thousands of students.

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.text: Oh, what a great man he was!

lines.speaker: Nurse
lines.text: By the way, it might be interesting to know that your physician was one of Dr. Gharib 's students!

lines.speaker: Sara
lines.text: Really?! That 's interesting!

questions: Why was Dr. Gharib regarded as a kind physician?
Have you seen Dr. Gharib TV series?

2.title: Look it Up!
2.intro: Majid is going to choose a suitable dictionary for his English class. He is talking to his English teacher during the break.

lines.speaker: Majid
lines.text: Excuse me Mr. Iranmehr, I wonder if you could help me.

lines.speaker: Mr. Iranmehr
lines.text: Sure. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: Majid
lines.text: I 'd like some information about a good English dictionary.

lines.speaker: Mr. Iranmehr
lines.text: Oh, well. Have you ever used a dictionary?

lines.speaker: Majid
lines.text: Actually, I haven 't. But I've heard that using a good dictionary can really help me learn English better.

lines.speaker: Mr. Iranmehr
lines.text: That 's right. First, I recommend a learner's dictionary.

lines.speaker: Majid
lines.text: What is a learner's dictionary?

lines.speaker: Mr. Iranmehr
lines.text: It is designed for foreign students. It also helps them learn English better.

lines.speaker: Majid
lines.text: Is there only one type of it?

lines.speaker: Mr. Iranmehr
lines.text: No, in fact dictionaries have different types, levels, and sizes.

lines.speaker: Majid
lines.text: What type do you suggest?

lines.speaker: Mr. Iranmehr
lines.text: I suppose a monolingual dictionary is more suitable for you, because you can find word information in English.

lines.speaker: Majid
lines.text: And what about levels?

lines.speaker: Mr. Iranmehr
lines.text: Well, there are usually three levels: elementary, intermediate and advanced. For you as a high school student, an elementary one is OK.

lines.speaker: Majid
lines.text: Do I need a small size one?

lines.speaker: Mr. Iranmehr
lines.text: Yes, a pocket dictionary. You can carry it wherever you go.

lines.speaker: Majid
lines.text: Oh, it's very good. And hmm..., is it expensive?

lines.speaker: Mr. Iranmehr
lines.text: No, such dictionaries are not expensive. By the way, you can use a free online dictionary, too. And also there are some free dictionaries for PCs and apps for smart phones.

lines.speaker: Majid
lines.text: Thanks, that's a good idea, but I 'd like to use a pocket dictionary!

questions: What type of dictionary does Mr. Iranmehr recommend?
What factors do you consider when you want to choose a dictionary?
What type of dictionary do you often use?

3.title: Renewable Energy
3.intro: Emad and his father are traveling to Guilan. On the way, in Manjeel, Emad sees huge wind turbines.

lines.speaker: Emad
lines.text: Daddy, look at those big fans!

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: They are actually wind turbines.

lines.speaker: Emad
lines.text: Wind turbines?

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Yes, wind turbines are used to produce electricity from wind power.

lines.speaker: Emad
lines.text: I know electricity can be produced from water and sunlight. How might it be generated from wind?

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: Well, a wind turbine works the opposite of a fan. Instead of using electricity to make wind, a turbine uses wind to make electricity. It is a type of clean energy.

lines.speaker: Emad
lines.text: These wind turbines remind me of what I read about using wind power in Yazd's buildings.

lines.speaker: Father
lines.text: You mean wind towers?

questions: Where are Emad and his father?
Has Emad ever traveled to Yazd?
What types of clean energy can you find in your city or village?
